name: Andhra Pradesh
note: Telangana is not a separate polygon on this map. MOSPI publishes a 2011–12-base series for residual Andhra Pradesh and a parallel series for Telangana (backcast through 2011–12). The split array holds the Telangana figures. Undivided Andhra Pradesh GSDP before 2 June 2014 is not the same unit.

name: Chhattisgarh
note: Created on 1 November 2000 from sixteen districts of Madhya Pradesh. Pre-2000 Madhya Pradesh figures on this map include the territory that became Chhattisgarh.

name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli
note: RBI Table 4 notes that from 2020 the Dadra and Nagar Haveli infant-mortality figures include Daman and Diu. The 2021 and 2023 IMR points are therefore duplicated onto both Union Territory polygons. The two territories were merged as a single UT in January 2020; this outline still draws them separately.

name: Daman and Diu
note: RBI Table 4 marks Daman and Diu IMR as not available from 2020 and states that Dadra and Nagar Haveli figures include Daman and Diu. The 2021 and 2023 IMR points repeat that merged series. MOSPI does not publish a separate GSDP series for this polygon in the 2011–12-base tables used here.

name: Gujarat
note: RBI Table 22 (constant 2011–12 GSDP) does not publish a 2023–24 figure for Gujarat; the 2023 point therefore carries per-capita NSDP from Table 10 without a GSDP total.

name: Jammu and Kashmir
note: The Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019 (appointed day 31 October 2019) created the Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. RBI notes that NSDP/GSDP from 2011–12 to 2018–19 relate to Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh together; from 2019–20 they relate to the UT of Jammu and Kashmir only.

name: Jharkhand
note: Created on 15 November 2000 from southern Bihar. Pre-2000 Bihar figures include the territory that became Jharkhand.

name: Ladakh
note: Ladakh became a Union Territory on 31 October 2019. MOSPI/RBI GSDP tables in this compilation do not publish a separate Ladakh series. SRS infant-mortality tables likewise do not list Ladakh as a reporting unit. The card is present so the 2019 reorganisation can be read against the Jammu and Kashmir series.

name: Odisha
note: The map label is Orissa (NAME_1). The state was renamed Odisha in 2011. The series is the MOSPI/RBI Odisha series.

name: Uttarakhand
note: The map label is Uttaranchal (NAME_1). The state was created as Uttaranchal on 9 November 2000 and renamed Uttarakhand in 2007. Income and IMR series begin after the split from Uttar Pradesh.
